text: As the City of Toronto experiences unprecedented growth, it is also experiencing significant road safety concerns. In Ward 19, many residents are seeking to curb volume, speed and irreverence of traffic signage on their streets by requesting a traffic review from Transportation Services for calming measures. On behalf of the Montrose Ave residents who reside between College and Dundas St W and who are concerned about the safety of the most vulnerable on their street, I kindly request Transportation Services to review and make this segment of Montrose Ave safer for all users.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed Transportation Services to conduct a traffic study followed by a poll of Montrose Ave between College and Dundas St W on the installation of calming measures to address resident safety concerns regarding speeding and report back to Toronto and East York Community Council
